title: Understanding the Data
text: Look at the data provided. You have two quantitative variables: temperature and workout time. Think about how these variables might relate to each other and how you can visualize this relationship.

title: Choosing the Right Plot
text: Which type of plot is suitable for visualizing the relationship between two quantitative variables?

title: Contour Plot Explanation
text: A contour plot is useful for visualizing three-dimensional data in two dimensions, showing the density of data points. Consider if this is appropriate for your two variables.
